page.overview:
Who is Akrah?

Akrah is one of three who can be found at debating the cause of the ' extinction, the other two being his brothers and . He theorizes that the went extinct to a volcanic eruption. However, while of the three scientists have been able to locate any , they do have an idea of where to find them. Akrah will ask if he's willing to travel to these locations to find the bones and return with a . He also asks that these include the heads of the animals. He will offer a reward of 300 , and accepting will activate the "" .

The specific Akrah wants to see is the , which is located in the region of . Link can take a photo of it with the . When he shows the picture to Akrah, he will be shocked at the quality. With the , he believes he'll be able to prove his theory about the volcanic eruption. If Link hasn't delivered to Onya or Garshon by the time he speaks to him, Akrah will ask Link to assist in their research as well.

After the quest is completed, Akrah will continue to debate the ' extinction with his brothers. He will explain that he's using the Link provided to his theory about the . At night, he mutters about heat in his sleep. On rainy days, he and his brothers stay inside the stable, and joins in on their conversations. He says they like to stay inside during rainy days, but quietly admits that it gives him a chance to talk with Zumi.
